name: NordVPN
author: Nord Security
summary: A VPN for Windows will improve your security while you’re connected to the internet on your PC. Enjoy more secure streaming, browsing, and work with NordVPN.
description: NordVPN encrypts your internet traffic and hides your IP and physical location. Works on 6 devices at once, on every major platform. With NordVPN, encrypt your online activity to protect your private data from hackers or snoopy advertisers. Enjoy global connectivity along with high-performance speed and secure access to streaming websites, censored content and social networks.

We’re elevating your online security one release at a time. This update comes with improvements and fixes for a top-notch NordVPN experience.

We’ve refreshed the “Monitor” tab — your pulse check for sensitive data exposures and unusual financial activity. Ideally, it stays quiet. If it doesn’t, Dark Web Monitor and transaction monitoring alerts will make sure you know about it.

Welcome to the “Protect” tab — a powerhouse that brings your defenses against online threats into one place. Manage real-time protection, check suspicious messages for scams, and review your protection activity.

* Our “Pause” button comes with a duration — and a good memory. Set your preferred duration once in the three-dot menu, and we’ll use it as your default pause time from then on.
* By popular demand, the “Disconnect” button is back next to “Pause.”
A few fixes here and there to ensure your VPN app works as expected.

When it comes to banking risks, fast reaction matters most. Transaction monitoring is now live and ready to scan your charges, flagging anything that looks out of the ordinary. Repeating transactions, suspicious vendors, unusual patterns — we’ll catch them instantly, giving you time to act.
Transaction monitoring is available with certain subscription plans using US bank accounts. You’ll find it next to Dark Web Monitor.

* Obfuscated servers now run on NordWhisper instead of OpenVPN. Why? To give you better speed and more locations.
* Tired of clicking through cookie banners? Then you’ll love the newest addition to our next-gen antivirus — a cookie banner hider. It reduces consent pop-ups as you browse, saving you time and effort.
* New functionality - Why stop at a dedicated IP? Get the whole dedicated server, with resources no one else uses and port forwarding for remote device access.
* New functionality - Why stop at a dedicated IP? Get the whole dedicated server, with resources no one else uses and port forwarding for remote device access.

* Map lovers shouldn’t have to rely only on country lists to pick a server. Nor do they have to any longer — the interactive map is back. Zoom in, drag around, and connect to a server right from the map. The world is yours!
* We’ve simplified the tray app to two core actions: “Open the NordVPN app” and “Quit.” The full experience is available in the main app — just a click away.
We’ve tinkered with the internal workings and polished some rough edges. The result? An app that’s better than ever before.

Meet our next-gen antivirus — scam, phishing, and malware protection, previously Threat Protection Pro. We rebuilt the entire experience to give you more powerful tools and greater control over your online safety.
We've heard the concern about missing P2P servers. Let us reassure you: P2P is thriving. In fact, all our regular servers now support P2P. Just pick a location, and you're good to go.

Sometimes a file looks suspicious but turns out to be perfectly fine. We believe in second chances, so when Threat Protection Pro detects a malicious download, it now quarantines it first. You can review quarantined files in the malware scanner and decide whether to delete them for good.

All journeys start at Home. We're excited to bring a new design that reduces unnecessary distractions and helps you focus on what matters most.

* Your go-to connection buttons now have the spotlight, ready to take you to your preferred locations with just a click.

* The Search expanded to cover more ground, so you can find countries, servers, and even Meshnet devices all in one place.

* The updated statistics section shows how long your connection stayed secure to give you a quick snapshot of your online habits.

This update may not bring visible changes, and that's okay. We've been tweaking things under the hood to ensure your NordVPN app runs smoother than ever. It's the invisible work that often makes the biggest difference.
Nothing to report this time, at least nothing you can see. But rest assured — we’re working hard behind the scenes to keep your NordVPN app running smoothly.

* You asked, we listened. You can now set your preferred location for the “Secure my connection” button. The default is “Fastest server” but you can change this setting to any country or server group instead. Once you do, the app will stick to that choice every time you click the button.
* Meet our brand-new AI-assisted recommendations for the fastest connection. Instead of relying on distance only, the smart selection considers several factors to pick the best server for your network conditions. Just choose “Fastest server” in the preferred location settings, and we’ll take it from there.
* Adventure is great, but clicking mystery links in your email? That’s a plot twist no one needs. The new email protection feature in Threat Protection Pro™ now scans URLs in your browser’s Gmail and Yahoo inboxes and flags the unsafe ones. To learn what the threat is, just hover over the warning icon that appears next to a link.

* The app will from now on try (and try again if need be) to restore your VPN connection if it ever drops for any reason. In doing so, it’ll keep leak protection active so your data stays safe even mid-connection.
* Our “Products” tab is growing up fast. The new “Your security suite” section shows what’s already protecting you — and what still needs a quick setup or just a click to turn it on. We’re not saying you should turn everything on… just that your security looks really good when you do.

Threat Protection Pro™ got a sharp and nifty anti-malware update.
* Now when the app detects a potentially harmful file, it’ll ask what you want to do — keep it or delete it. Choose wisely.
* If you prefer to skip the question, set the auto-delete rule under “Anti-malware” > “Malware scanner” > “Show settings” and let Threat Protection Pro™ follow its instincts.

Meshnet is here to stay! Over the past month, you’ve shared your voices and reminded us just how much it can offer — not simply as a feature, but as a way to share and connect. We hear you loud and clear: Meshnet will remain a part of NordVPN, with steady updates and solid support.

Threat Protection Pro™ has a new tool to keep you safer online:
* “Hijacked session alert” will let you know if your website login cookies show up in a stolen sessions database. It’s already on if your plan includes Threat Protection Pro™, keeping unwelcome guests out of your accounts.
VPN picked up a couple of handy updates:
* The “Pause” button got more time options — 5, 15, 30, or 60 minutes, or even 24 hours. Short break, long break, we’ve got all options covered.
* “Quick Connect” is now called “Secure my connection.” It’s the same one-click path to the best server, minus the name that may have left you wondering if “Slow Connect” was hiding somewhere.

* We reorganized our dashboard to make navigation easier. The map tab is now smoothly integrated into the dashboard, alongside the other features — Threat Protection and Dark Web Monitor. Fewer tabs, fewer clicks.
* Threat Protection Pro™ got extra armor. The crypto wallet address checker has landed under the advanced browsing protection category. Turn it on, and we’ll flag unsafe wallet addresses you may come across while browsing. After all, we’d prefer you don’t accidentally fund a scammer.

* The “Report a problem” form will enjoy a well-earned rest. We loved its old-school charm, but simplicity wins the round. The new “Help” section is now coming to your aid instead — you can easily reach our Support Center for quick answers or run diagnostics if something’s not working quite right.
* We’ve also done a bit of housekeeping to fix a few bugs and polish some rough edges.
Settings got a more intuitive navigation system. You know that moment — “Where was that option again?” You’ll be having fewer of those.

* From now on, Dark Web Monitor takes you directly to your Nord Account dashboard, where you can conveniently manage your monitored email addresses and review found leaks. You’ll still get alerts in the app, but the full details unfold on the web.
* If you’re a proud owner of a dedicated IP, you’ll find it at the top of your server list for faster access. If not, you’ll see a friendly banner instead – with an option to hide, of course.
* We’ve also included a few fixes to keep your VPN running smoothly, just as it should.

Threat Protection Pro™ now has a cleaner layout and a more polished look. It's easier to review blocked threats and fine-tune the settings. Unblocking a website is part of that smoother experience, should you choose to give it the green light. Just drive carefully.

* Threat Protection Pro™ is now available for ARM-based devices. Enjoy powerful protection against malware, trackers, and shady websites.
